certificates.main.title: Gift certificates
certificates.title: "ARBER" gift certificate
certificates.title.paragraph: An original and at the same time practical gift for friends or loved ones. With our certificate, you will no longer have the question "What to give this time". The convenience of such a gift is that you choose the denomination of the certificate, and the recipient decides for himself which product to spend it on. Thus, he will definitely receive the desired and correct gift.
certificates.title.paragraph1: Such a certificate can be given for any event, because everyone loves stylish clothes and will definitely be happy to update their wardrobe. Since ARBER produces clothes for men and women, a gift certificate can be called a universal present.
certificates.paragraph: You can purchase a certificate for an offline store or for an online store.
certificates.title1.paragraph1: For the offline store, there are denominations at
certificates.title1.paragraph3: UAH. Such a certificate can be purchased and used only in retail stores of our network.
certificates.title1.paragraph4: You can choose any desired denomination for the online store. Such a certificate can be used only in the online store.
certificates.title2.paragraph: The certificate is valid for 1 year from the moment of purchase (date of purchase).
certificates.title3: Certificates are valid only for ARBER products.
certificates.title3.paragraph: If the certificate has been purchased spent, the customer can exchange it for a similar product or another product, within the amount of the certificate.
